strengths_deep_dive: Qalam Education Fund maintains direct educational delivery models across multiple platforms, including the Qalam Seminary and digital podcasts. In FY2024, the organization directed <cite id="1">82.6% of its budget directly to program costs</cite>. Furthermore, its fundraising expense ratio is exceptionally low, requiring <cite id="1"><$0.01 per $1 raised in revenue</cite>, which ensures donor contributions directly fuel program operations rather than solicitation.
rich_narrative.summary: Founded in 2009, Qalam Education Fund provides Islamic learning through its seminary, online Arabic courses, community intensives, and digital media programs. In FY2024, the charity reported <cite id="3">Total Revenue of $2,329,468</cite> to support its educational mission. The organization operates primarily as a direct service institution in the United States, offering higher Islamic education and youth programs. Financial filings from FY2024 show a <cite id="1">Program expense ratio of 82.6%</cite>, indicating that the majority of spending directly supports educational programs rather than administration. However, financial records reveal an exceptionally large reserve balance equivalent to <cite id="1">109.7 months of working capital</cite>. For a <cite id="2">Zakat-eligible organization</cite>, accumulating nearly nine years of operating expenses creates a tension between institutional accumulation and the prompt distribution of religious funds.
